signal: Conversica shipped major AI agent advancements for enterprise revenue teams, leaning into generative AI to automate revenue touchpoints across email, SMS, and chat.

email.body1:
Ashley, saw Conversica shipped its brand-controlled AI agents to automate revenue touchpoints across email, SMS, and chat.

When the GTM motion gets that signal-rich, the bottleneck shifts to signal-to-action latency: in-market accounts surface faster than ops can route and the team can touch. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, turning signals into booked meetings with 3-5x more meetings per rep, no new headcount.

I built a signal play for Conversica off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Ashley, quick follow-up for Conversica.

The gap I see most in RevOps is not data volume, it is the lag between a signal firing and a personalized touch going out. Tighten that and measurable lift follows fast: our best-practice patterns alone usually move reply rates 50 to 70 percent.

Worth 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three things I would change, and where the signal-to-action handoff is leaking pipeline.
email.body3:
Ashley, last bit of proof for Conversica.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Conversica's reply rate likely compares to peer revenue-tech teams. Want to grab time so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Ashley, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If cutting signal-to-action latency is not on the roadmap this quarter, no problem at all. I know an ops calendar fills up fast around new product rollouts.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your GTM systems? I will tailor it to Conversica either way.
